out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: PIC Duties, Train Employees on Holding Temps
violations.observation: Employees are not routinely monitoring the temperatures of Time/Temperature Control for Safety foods during hot and cold holding. Employee failed to monitor hot holding temperatures of TCS food items in steam wells.
violations.corrective_action: The Person in Charge or Certified Food Manager shall designate employees to monitor the cold holding and hot holding of time/temperature control for safety foods. The employees shall be trained in using a calibrated food thermometer to ensure proper temperatures. EHS reviewed proper hot holding procedures with the PIC. The employee was instructed to ensure steam wells are filled adequately so the hot water makes contact with the bottom of the metal pans. The employee must monitor the temperatures of all TCS foods held in steam wells using a calibrated thermometer. All hot-held foods must be maintained at or above 135°F.

violations.title: PIC Duties, Inspect Food Condition and Temp
violations.observation: Based on a discussion with the PIC/CFM, food employees are not inspecting the food upon receipt to verify proper temperature and intact packaging.
violations.corrective_action: The Person in Charge or certified food manager shall designate employees to inspect the food upon receipt from the licensed vendors. The employees shall visibly observe the foods as they are received to determine that they are from approved sources, delivered at the required temperatures of 41F or less, 135F or above, or frozen solid, the temperatures of the foods are documented in a daily log book, and protected from contamination. EHS provided training to the Person in Charge (PIC) on proper receiving procedures for TCS foods. The PIC was instructed to verify and document the internal temperature of select TCS food items upon delivery using a calibrated food thermometer. Items received above 41°F must be rejected and returned to the supplier. The temperature should be written on the invoice next to the corresponding food item.

violations.title: PIC Duties, No Unnecessary Persons
violations.observation: Unauthorized personnel, such as children or customers, were observed present in the food preparation, food storage, or warewashing areas. Observed a family member of an employee eating in the preparation area.
violations.corrective_action: Persons unnecessary to the food establishment operation are not allowed in the food preparation, food storage, or ware washing areas of the commercial establishment. Only approved tours or brief visits may be authorized by the Person in Charge or certified food manager if steps are taken to ensure that exposed food, clean equipment/utensils, clean linens, and single service items are protected from contamination. The family member was asked to leave the food preparation area immediately. The PIC was advised that only authorized staff may be present in food handling areas and that eating is only permitted in designated, non-food areas.

violations.title: Food Manager Certificate & Responsibility
violations.observation: There is no Certified Food Manager present at the beginning of the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager. It is highly suggested that you have more than one employee with the food manager's license. ORS Interactive, Inc. (see handout provided) issues the required photo identification card with proof of successful completion of a certified food manager's exam. Failure to have a certified food manager on site during ALL hours of operation including food preparation, food service, and cleaning/sanitizing of equipment/utensils will result in closure of the establishment. CFM arrived approximately 15 minutes after the start of the inspection

out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: A food employee was observed eating, smoking, or drinking in areas where they may contaminate food, clean equipment, utensils or other items needing protection. A family member of an employee was observed eating in the food preparation area.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may only eat, drink, or use tobacco in a designated area like a dining room or office area. Employees shall not eat or drink in the kitchen areas, warewashing areas, or storage areas where items may become contaminated. The family member was asked to leave the food preparation area immediately. The PIC was advised that only authorized staff may be present in food handling areas and that eating is only permitted in designated, non-food areas.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the @LOCATION@ being used @OBSERVATION@. The handwashing sink in the warewashing area is not operational and was being used to store metal covers instead of its intended purpose.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. An alternative handwashing sink will be provided until the current sink is repaired and fully operational. OCEAN PARADISE RESTAURANT & BAR (Inspection Date: 10/06/2025) Page 3 of 5

out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Shellstock not Commingled
violations.observation: Shellstock from one tagged/labeled container are commingled with shellstock from a different container with different certification numbers; different harvest dates; or different growing areas before being ordered by a consumer. A container of oysters in the walk-in refrigerator was found with two shellstock tags from the same supplier but with different harvest dates, indicating the oysters were commingled
violations.corrective_action: Shellstock from different tagged/labeled bags cannot be commingled if they have different certification numbers; different harvest dates; or different growing areas before being ordered by a consumer. The CFM voluntarily discarded the commingled oysters. EHS reviewed shellstock handling and tagging requirements with the CFM, emphasizing that shellstock from different harvest dates must be stored separately with their original tags to ensure proper traceability

violations.title: Shellstock Removed from Tagged or Labeled Container
violations.observation: Shellstock has been removed from the tagged/labeled container without preserving source identification. Mussels and clams stored in Unit #3 without the required identification tags attached.
violations.corrective_action: Shellstock that has been removed from the tagged/labeled container must have a system used to identify source. The CFM voluntarily discarded the mussels and clams without tag information. EHS provided training on shellstock tagging requirements and instructed that a copy of the original tag must be placed in a sealed plastic bag and attached to the storage container.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: Dish machine
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. EHS instructed the PIC to wash, rinse, and sanitize wares manually in the 3-compartment sink until the dish machine is repaired and can consistently reach the required sanitizer concentration

violations.title: Food Contact Surfaces Clean to Sight & Touch
violations.observation: The following equipment/utensils were observed soiled to sight and touch: The interior tray ramp on the right side of the ice machine was observed soiled with visible residue.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be clean to the sight and touch. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. The PIC was instructed to clean and sanitize the affected area of the ice machine immediately.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Observed Mashed potato ( steam wells) at 116F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. CFM reheated mashed potato to 172 on stove.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Observed unsalted butter in unit # 3 at 48F, crab stuffed mushrooms in unit # 2 at 47F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CFM discarded unsalted butter from unit # 3, crab stuffed mushrooms from unit # 2

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: Observed cooked chicken, clam chowder soup and pico de gallo with no date label
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. CFM labeled cooked chicken, clam chowder soup and pico de gallo with the preparation and expiration date

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food
violations.observation: A review of the menu with the foodservice operator indicates that there is no consumer advisory for the following food item(s) that may be served raw and/or undercooked: During the inspection, the 4th Anniversary Menu, Happy Hour Menu, Brunch Menu, and Regular Menu were found missing proper consumer advisory disclosures and asterisks identifying raw or undercooked items. Items such as oysters, NY strip, poached eggs.
violations.corrective_action: If an animal food such as beef, eggs, fish, lamb, milk, pork, poultry, or shellfish is served or sold raw or undercooked the permit holder shall inform consumers of the significantly increased risk of consuming such foods by way of a disclosure and reminder using brochures, deli case or menu advisories, label statements, table tents, placards, or other effective written means. EHS marked all necessary corrections in red pen directly on each menu, including where to place asterisks and the required consumer advisory statement. The person in charge was instructed to update all menus accordingly to ensure compliance

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Poison/Toxic Materials Necessary to Operation
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. Spray paint cans were observed stored near the soda dispensers
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored to prevent contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items by separating the poisonous and toxic materials by spacing or partitioning. The person in charge was instructed to immediately remove the spray paint and relocate it to a designated chemical storage area away from food and beverages

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: A bulk container of rice, a bulk container of panko, and a spray bottle containing oil were observed without identifying labels
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. The CFM labeled the rice, panko, and oil spray bottle during the inspection.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter. Wet wiping cloths were observed left out on kitchen counters throughout the facility
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. The person in charge was instructed to remove the cloths from surfaces and place them in sanitizer solution.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equipment/Utensils Air Drying
violations.observation: Plastic containers were found stacked while wet after cleaning and chemical sanitization.
violations.corrective_action: After cleaning and sanitizing, equipment and utensils shall be air-dried or used after adequate draining before contact with food. CFM immediately unlatch containers and let them dry properly

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not corrosion resistant, nonabsorbent, and/or smooth: A foil wrapper was observed placed directly on the countertop surface
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. The person in charge was instructed to remove the foil immediately and ensure that only approved, cleanable surfaces are used in food preparation areas.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. A hose with a spray nozzle was observed connected to the mop sink faucet without a backflow prevention device installed
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. The person in charge was instructed to immediately install an approved backflow prevention device (specifically the type shown in the reference photo during the inspection) at the mop sink faucet, or to remove the spray nozzle until proper protection is in place.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Plumbing connections under the back sink piping are leaking.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Mops Allowed to Air Dry
violations.observation: Observed that mops are improperly stored between use. : A mop was observed stored in standing dirty water in the mop bucket
violations.corrective_action: Store mops in a position that allows them to air dry without soiling walls, equipment, or supplies. The person in charge was instructed to remove the mop from the dirty water and hang it to air dry properly.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the Ceiling is not maintained in good repair. Gaps were observed in the ceiling near the syrup lines
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. The person in charge was advised to seal all ceiling gaps near the syrup lines to prevent pest intrusion and maintain a cleanable surface
